notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.2.0 Update
notes.content:
This update includes important fixes, UI improvements, and new audio content:

🛵 Fixed the shaking issue with the moped.

🚗 Pressing G now teleports vehicles to your scrapyard.

🗺️ Minimap has been temporarily disabled.

✅ Task list text is now more visible.

⚙️ Adjustments made to the Game Settings menu.

🎵 7 new background tracks added.

🌿 Ambient sounds have been added to the game.

Thanks for your feedback—enjoy the game!

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.1 Update
notes.content:
This update improves in-game guidance with new tips and helpful UI hints:

🧾 A tip board was added to the office explaining how to use the Organizer and Shredder.

🚗 A prompt now shows how to enter vehicles and open the trunk when near one.

🛠️ A message now tells you which key to press to open the Garage.

🏠 Hints have been added to explain how to sell storage units.

We're working to make the game easier to understand—thank you for your feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes – v1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
This update adds support for two new languages!

🗣️ Polish language support

🗣️ Portuguese language support

More players can now enjoy the game in their native language. We truly appreciate your feedback!

notes.title: Patch Notes - v1.0.1 Update
notes.content:
This update brings several improvements to enhance your gameplay experience:

🔧 Various bugs have been fixed.

🔊 Audio cues have been added to notify you when your character is hungry.

🧃 Icons for plastic and glass items have been updated to make sorting easier.

Your feedback means a lot to us. Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Scrap Dealer Simulator - Now Available!
notes.content:
Scrap Dealer Simulator puts you in charge of a run-down scrapyard business. Your mission? Collect junk, recycle, build machines, expand your base, and grow your scrapyard empire!
In the full release version, you’ll experience a large explorable map, processable materials, detailed crafting systems, and upgradable stations.
Sort your trash, operate machines, explore new areas, and invest smartly to maximize profit. This isn’t just scrap, this is survival and strategy!

notes.title: Escape Debt, Reborn in the Scrap Yard!
notes.content:
"It's time to escape your debts and make a fresh start! Your only way out of the debt trap is to take refuge in the old scrapyard left by your grandfather. Rusted machines, a rundown depot, and scattered scrap – this is your new life!

Step into the process of using your grandfather’s machines to gather scrap, rummage through junk, and break down old items to produce new materials. You'll need to survive by selling your processed goods at the town's second-hand shop, managing hunger and thirst along the way. But surviving isn’t enough – to truly break free from your debts, you must expand your business by acquiring new production stations, storage spaces, and larger vehicles.

What Can You Do?
🔧 Gather & Dismantle Scrap: Collect abandoned metals, machines, and old items to convert them into valuable materials.
🚛 Drive Vehicles: Purchase new vehicles to transport more scrap and increase your cargo capacity.
💰 Second-Hand Trading: Sell your processed products at the town’s second-hand shop to earn money.
🍽 Survival Mechanics: Manage your hunger and thirst while you fight for survival.
🏭 Expand Your Business: Grow your enterprise with new production stations and storage areas.
🏚 Buy & Explore Depots: Take a chance on mysterious depots that could yield huge profits—or losses.
🛠 Scrap Processing: Transform raw materials into more valuable products to boost your earnings.
🌎 Open World Exploration: Discover the town and its surroundings to find rare and valuable scrap.

Building your own scrapyard empire is the key to escaping your debts and starting a new life. If you're ready, jump into this adventure and change your destiny!"
